_meta.denominator: the player's own team's red-zone plays of that type, so the share isolates his claim on the offense's scoring opportunity rather than describing how often the offense got there

gates.note: a share is emitted only when the player AND his team clear the gate. A count with no share means the sample is too thin to express as a rate — that absence is information, not a gap

_meta.hierarchy_rank: 1 — opportunity, and specifically the scoring-equity half of it that Lens 1 requires be tracked separately from snap share
_meta.not_a_projection: Red-zone usage is among the most coaching-dependent things in football. A new OC can reassign a goal-line role in one week, so this describes 2025 deployment and is superseded by any dated role note.
_meta.source: nflverse pbp, REG only, two-point plays excluded
